newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fuji Bank HK sets HK$5 bln CD programme.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank HK sets HK$5 bln CD programme.

text.p: Fuji Bank, acting through its Hong Kong branch, has established a HK$5.0 billion Hong Kong dollar certificate of deposit programme, sole arranger Fuji International Finance (HK) said on Friday.
Under the programme, Fuji Bank can issue Hong Kong dollar fixed rate, floating rate or discounted certificates of deposit.
Hong Kong law is the governing law of the programme.
The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corp is agent for the programme. A dealer group is being formed.
The first issue off the programme, a HK$1.0 billion floating rate certificate of deposit issue was launched today, the arranger said.
